caption:
Most front desks end every call the same way.

"Let me get your info and we'll call you back."

That line hands the caller time to think, compare, and dial the next name on Google.

The fix costs nothing and takes one sentence.

End every call with a two-option booking question:

"Does Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon work better for you?"

Two choices beat an open-ended maybe. The caller picks one and the job goes on the calendar before they hang up.

Train your team to say it out loud on the next ten calls this week.

The Black Arrow platform turns that same instinct into booking links and two-way texting that run automatically.
